nb=10
def model(p):
    n=p[0]
    B=p[1:1+nb];C=p[1+nb:1+2*nb];k=np.exp(p[1+2*nb:1+3*nb])
    b=bid
    return B[b]+C[b]*(1-np.exp(-k[b]*A**n))

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=np.asarray(df['t']);A=np.asarray(df['A']);y=np.asarray(df['dA_dt'])
v=np.var(y)
b=lambda p: p[0]+p[1]/t+p[2]*t+p[3]*np.exp(-t)
forms={
 'H1 hill Kt': (lambda p: b(p)+(p[4]+p[5]*t)*A**p[8]/(np.exp(p[6]+p[7]*t)**p[8]+A**p[8]), 9),
 'H2 expo kt': (lambda p: b(p)+(p[6]+p[7]*t+p[8]*t**2)*(1-np.exp(-np.exp(p[4]+p[5]*t)*A**p[9])), 10),
 'H3 hill lin': (lambda p: b(p)+(p[6]+p[7]*t)*A**p[8]/(p[4]+p[5]*t+A**p[8]), 9),
 'H4 two MM': (lambda p: b(p)+(p[4]+p[5]*t)*A/(p[6]+A)+p[7]*t*A/(p[8]+A), 9),
 'H5 scaled A': (lambda p: b(p)+(p[4]+p[5]*t)*(1-np.exp(-(A*np.exp(p[6]*t))**p[7]*p[8])), 9),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
for name,(f,k) in forms.items():
    best=(9e9,None)
    for trial in range(40):
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,k)+0.5
        p0[0]=rng.normal(-9,2)
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(p)-y,nan=1e6,posinf=1e6,neginf=-1e6), p0, method='trf', max_nfev=3000)
            s=np.mean(r.fun**2)/v
            if np.isfinite(s) and s<best[0]: best=(s,r.x)
        except Exception: pass
    print(name,"NMSE %.3e"%best[0], np.round(best[1],3) if best[1] is not None else None)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t)
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t + p[9]*t**2
    S = 1 - np.exp(-p[6]*np.abs(A)**p[7]*t**p[8])
    return base + amp*S
